messages.subject: Whitmore — Settlement Agreement mark-up (v2 redline)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Our tracked-changes mark-up is attached (v2). As Deepa noted, the changes are limited: 14-day payment window, non-derogatory undertaking extended to directors, and a confidentiality carve-out for explaining the reason for leaving to future employers. We hope these are acceptable so we can move to execution.

Eleanor
